verses.en: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.pt: Ah DEUS, nosso Senhor, quão glorioso é o teu nome sobre toda a terra! Pois tu puseste tua majestade acima dos céus.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth, who has set your glory above the heavens!
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker on the Gittith. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, our Lord, whose glory is higher than the heavens, how noble is your name in all the earth!

verses.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.pt: Da boca das crianças, e dos que mamam, tu fundaste força, por causa de teus adversários, para fazer cessar ao inimigo e ao vingador.
verses.en_web: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
verses.en_bbe: You have made clear your strength even out of the mouths of babies at the breast, because of those who are against you; so that you may put to shame the cruel and violent man.

verses.en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.pt: Quando eu vejo teus céus, obra de teus dedos; a lua e as estrelas, que tu preparaste;
verses.en_web: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
verses.en_bbe: When I see your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have put in their places;

verses.en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.pt: O que é o homem, para que tu te lembres dele? E o que é o filho do homem, para que o visites?
verses.en_web: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
verses.en_bbe: What is man, that you keep him in mind? the son of man, that you take him into account?

verses.en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.pt: E tu o fizeste um pouco menor que os anjos; e com glória e honra tu o coroaste.
verses.en_web: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.en_bbe: For you have made him only a little lower than the gods, crowning him with glory and honour.

verses.en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.pt: Tu o fazes ter controle sobre as obras de tuas mãos; tudo puseste debaixo de seus pés.
verses.en_web: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
verses.en_bbe: You have made him ruler over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet;

verses.en: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.pt: Ovelhas e bois, todos eles, e também os animais do campo;
verses.en_web: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
verses.en_bbe: All sheep and oxen, and all the beasts of the field;

verses.en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.pt: As aves dos céus, e os peixes do mar; e os que passam pelos caminhos dos mares.
verses.en_web: The birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
verses.en_bbe: The birds of the air and the fish of the sea, and whatever goes through the deep waters of the seas.

verses.en: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.pt: Ó DEUS, nosso Senhor! Quão glorioso é o teu nome sobre toda a terra! Salmo de Davi, para o regente, em “Mute-Laben”:
verses.en_web: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, our Lord, how noble is your name in all the earth!
